description: Additional non-LeetCode candidate-reported company OA questions after duplicate exclusion.

records.title: Count Pairs of Natural Numbers with GCD Equal to a Given Number
records.evidenceNote: Reported in the Siemens EDA SDE on-campus interview experience. The report specifies a 90-minute HackerEarth OA with two coding questions and identifies this as the first coding question. Evidence report: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/interview-experiences/siemens-eda-interview-experience-for-sde-role-on-campus/
records.statement: Count the number of pairs of natural numbers whose greatest common divisor equals a given integer, subject to the assessment constraints.

records.title: Connect N Ropes with Minimum Cost (Min-Heap Variation)
records.evidenceNote: Reported as the second coding problem in a Morgan Stanley summer-intern Mettl OA. The candidate describes it as a min-heap variation of the minimum-cost rope-joining problem. Evidence report: https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/interview-experiences/morgan-stanley-interview-experience-2021-2/
records.statement: Given ropes of different lengths, repeatedly connect two ropes at a time. The cost of each connection is the sum of the two rope lengths. Determine the minimum total cost to connect all ropes into one rope.
